figures.name: quality-transitions
figures.title: Cartpole quality at fixed saved checkpoints
figures.description: Faint curves are all four seeds; solid curves are means and shading is observed seed range, not a confidence interval. For wall-time curves the mean line uses mean checkpoint wall; individual seed curves retain their actual times.

figures.name: quality-training_process_seconds
figures.title: Cartpole quality at fixed saved checkpoints
figures.description: Faint curves are all four seeds; solid curves are means and shading is observed seed range, not a confidence interval. For wall-time curves the mean line uses mean checkpoint wall; individual seed curves retain their actual times.

figures.name: protocol-wall
figures.title: Full run wall includes startup and saved-policy evaluation
figures.description: Bars show seed means; whiskers show min/max complete protocol wall. Startup/other is full training process minus recorded training loop. Checkpoint/logging costs may be nested in the loop and are itemized separately, never added twice. Runtime installation and source transfer are excluded.

figures.name: threshold-intervals
figures.title: Time to the predeclared balancing gate is interval censored
figures.description: Segments span the previous checkpoint to the first passing checkpoint; dots are observed successful checks. Right-pointing markers are runs that never passed within the fixed budget. No interpolation or early stopping.
